# Creator OS

> The definitive content creation operating system and AI workspace for digital creators, video clippers, and media agencies.

## Core Navigation & Features
- [Creator OS Homepage](https://www.creator-os.online/): Main landing page and workflow dashboard.
- [Idea Studio](https://www.creator-os.online/#idea-studio): Converts 1 raw topic or URL into 10 distinct viral angles.
- [Hook Engine](https://www.creator-os.online/#hook-engine): Evaluates opening video hooks against 3-second retention benchmarks.
- [Caption OS](https://www.creator-os.online/#caption-os): Produces platform-specific, keyword-optimized captions for TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Instagram Reels.
- [Campaign OS](https://www.creator-os.online/#campaign-os): Visual Kanban workflow to manage multi-day content sprints.
- [Feature Comparison Matrix](https://www.creator-os.online/#comparison): Breakdown of Creator OS vs. spreadsheets and generic AI tools.
- [Pricing Plans](https://www.creator-os.online/#pricing): Transparent subscription pricing ($29 Creator, $49 Pro, $149 Agency).
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.creator-os.online/#faq): Comprehensive answers regarding platform capabilities, hook scoring, and agency workspaces.

## System Details
Creator OS replaces fragmented productivity tools (Notion, Google Docs, spreadsheets) with an integrated video production pipeline for high-retention content creation.
